info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Direct Debit Mandates API
info.description: The Manage Direct Debit Mandates API enables businesses to establish and manage direct debit mandates linked to specified bank accounts. By utilizing this API, users can submit requests to create new mandates or modify existing ones, ensuring seamless payment processing for recurring transactions. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions and service providers that require reliable automated payment solutions. Typical consumers include banking applications, payment processors, and any businesses that handle subscription or recurring billing models.

post.summary: Create a new direct debit mandate for a specific account.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new direct debit mandate associated with the specified account. Ensure to provide all necessary details to successfully set up the mandate, which can be used for automatic withdrawals in the future.
